blocks.html:
FULL CAR WRAP IN TORONTO

A full car wrap is when more than 75% of a car is covered with vinyl material. At Vinyl Wrap Toronto we have successfully and gracefully finished a lot of full wrap jobs. Full Car wraps are quite popular among people who just want to change the colour of their car. But there are some cases where people want a completely customized vinyl wrap on their vehicle. Vinyl Wrap Toronto offers a variety of colour options to choose from.

We use Avery Dennison & 3M Vinyl wraps that are known to have the widest colour spectrum on the market.
Besides having the option to choose from a variety of different colours, we also offer vinyl wraps in different finishes such as Matte, Gloss, and Satin. Carbon & Brushed are our two most demanded vinyl wrap finishes. Our team of graphic designers is ready to help turn your ideas into an eye-catching wrap.

The reason for getting a full wrap varies from customer to customer. It could either be for commercial or personal reasons. When it comes to full wraps for commercial purposes, customers go for a custom-designed graphic that reflects their vision. In most cases, it is an advertisement that goes all around the vehicle.

Getting a full vehicle wrap to spread awareness about your business is a very cost-effective and non-aggressive way of advertisement. However, for personal wraps, people usually just want a plain colour change.
Getting a full Car wrap is a great way to update your vehicle.

In very rare cases, people like to go beyond and wrap the door jams of their cars as well when they want a greater level of detail. Since wrapping door jams is tricky, it costs a bit extra than what it costs for a standard full wrap. Ultimately the customer’s decision to wrap the door jams depends on how detailed they want the wrap to be.

Have a question regarding the car wrap cost? Send us a quick message with your requirements and our team will get back to you with an approximate price.
Give us a call today at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON M9W 1B4 to discuss your options
